Denison Mines (DNN — first new large-scale Canadian uranium mine in 20+ years using in-situ recovery, pre-revenue, the most speculative name). QuantumScape (QS — solid-state EV batteries charging to 80% in under 15 minutes with ~2x energy density, Eagle pilot line shipping samples, VW's PowerCo licensed for up to 1M vehicles/year, second top-10 automaker customer, first meaningful revenue ~2027). Aurora Innovation (AUR — first fully driverless commercial freight on US roads, 250K driverless miles with zero collisions, fleet scaling from 10 to 200+ trucks, 80K-driver shortage as demand backdrop).
